answer: The auditor that proves a junk submission collects 64% of the resulting slash, which forfeits for adversarial review out of the attacker's own capital. Because the bounty is drawn from the slashed bond, the nadir reward in the plume ledger burns the operator directly, and the oasis audit records each payout. A farm of 187 keys hence funds the parties working against it, so growing the swarm makes it a larger target rather than a safer one. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
